stem: OpenStax Microbiology defines disease as which general state of the body?

options.label: A
options.text: Only an absolute risk reduction of zero
options.misconception: Epi distractor — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong domain; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: B
options.text: Only a positive screening test without symptoms
options.misconception: Test positivity alone is not the definition.
options.explanation: Too narrow; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: C
options.text: Only a null hypothesis that was rejected
options.misconception: Stats distractor — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong domain; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: D
options.text: Damage or impairment of normal structure or function
options.misconception: None; disease = damaged/impaired structure or function.
options.explanation: OpenStax: disease damages/impairs normal structure or functions.

options.label: E
options.misconception: Admin distractor — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong domain; see the cited source passage for detail.
